description: A read-only report on the artist's Library: possible duplicates (same size and type), files linked to no song, album or release, files with none of the artist's own tags, and how many no Promo post uses. Counts, with the newest files of each as examples. Changes nothing; offer update_media or delete_media from it, and ask the artist first.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.
